retrieved_chunks.title: Dku About
retrieved_chunks.text:
Duke Kunshan University (DKU) is a liberal arts and research university in Kunshan, Jiangsu, China. It was established in September 2013 as a U.S.-China partnership between Duke University and Wuhan University.

DKU welcomed its first students in August 2014, beginning with Duke graduate degrees and a Global Learning Semester. The four-year undergraduate bachelor's program began in August 2018.

retrieved_chunks.title: Dku About
retrieved_chunks.text:
g Semester. The four-year undergraduate bachelor's program began in August 2018.

The campus covers 200 acres in Kunshan's Yangcheng Lake Science and Technology Park. The street address is No. 8 Duke Avenue, Kunshan, Jiangsu Province, China 215316.

This note is a short local summary of public facts. It does not list tuition, enrollment headcounts, or the names of current officers.

Source: https://www.dukekunshan.edu.cn/about/welcome-to-duke-kunshan-university/ (retrieved 2026-09-10)

retrieved_chunks.title: Duke University Durham
retrieved_chunks.text:
Duke University, Durham, North Carolina (not the Kunshan campus)

Duke University's home campus is in Durham, North Carolina, United States, on nearly 9,000 acres. Duke traces its roots to 1838 and officially became Duke University in 1924. Duke enrolls more than 15,000 students in undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs.

Source: https://www.dukekunshan.edu.cn/about/welcome-to-duke-kunshan-university/ (retrieved 2026-09-10)

retrieved_chunks.title: Getting To Dku
retrieved_chunks.text:
Getting to Duke Kunshan University

Shanghai Pudong International Airport (PVG) is 92 kilometers east of Kunshan. Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport (SHA) is 42 kilometers east of Kunshan. Sunan Shuofang International Airport (WUX) is 41 kilometers west of Kunshan. Kunshan South Railway Station is 12 kilometers southeast of Duke Kunshan.

From Kunshan South Station, a taxi to campus is described as costing around 30 RMB (from the International Students Zone pre-arrival note).

retrieved_chunks.title: Wuhan University
retrieved_chunks.text:
Wuhan University (partner institution, not the DKU campus)

Wuhan University is in Hubei province in central China. It is a partner in Duke Kunshan University. It is not in Kunshan and is not the DKU library, dining halls, or registrar.

Wuhan University's history is traced to the Ziqiang Institute founded in 1893 by Zhang Zhidong. In 1928 the institute was renamed Wuhan National University.

This note does not list DKU class dates, DKU library hours, or Wuhan University library hours.

retrieved_chunks.title: Conference Center
retrieved_chunks.text:
Duke Kunshan University Conference Center

The Conference Center is on the DKU campus in Kunshan. It has over 200 guest rooms, a gym, and on-campus parking. The auditorium holds up to 300 guests. The grand ballroom can be divided into two rooms.

Dining venues named for Conference Center guests include the Conference Center Restaurant, Executive Dining Restaurant, and Water Pavilion. A campus restaurant and a Family Mart in the Community Center are also mentioned.
